title: Grapevine Hairy Root Culture Establishment and Maintenance Protocol
author: Sasha Tietz

steps.title: Streak R. rhizogenes on YM agar
steps.instruction: Streak Rhizobium rhizogenes onto yeast‑mannitol (YM) agar plates supplemented with 25 µg/mL Rifampicin and the appropriate selection antibiotic (if a binary vector is present). Incubate plates in the dark at 28 °C.

steps.title: Collect bacterial colonies into tubes
steps.instruction: Decant the grown R. rhizogenes colonies into 50 mL Falcon tubes for further processing.

steps.title: Prepare pre‑culture in YM broth
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL of YM broth with a single isolated R. rhizogenes colony. Incubate in the dark at 28 °C while shaking at 120 rpm.

steps.title: Scale up culture to OD 0.8‑1
steps.instruction: Add 100–200 µL of the pre‑culture to 50 mL of YM broth in a 100 mL Erlenmeyer flask. Incubate in the dark at 28 °C while shaking at 120 rpm until the optical density at 600 nm reaches 0.8–1.

steps.title: Harvest bacteria by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture at 5 000 rpm and decant the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend bacteria with acetosyringone
steps.instruction: Wash the remaining pellet in half‑strength Murashige and Skoog (½ MS) medium, centrifuge again at 5 000 rpm, and resuspend the pellet in 25 mL ½ MS supplemented with 250 µM acetosyringone. The bacterial suspension can be stored at 4 °C for up to 1 hour before use.

substeps.instruction: Wash pellet in ½ MS medium.
Resuspend in 25 mL ½ MS + 250 µM acetosyringone.

steps.title: Excise grapevine internode explants
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel and tweezers, excise internode tissue from grapevine plantlets that are approximately 20 cm tall.

steps.title: Place explant growth point on MS agar
steps.instruction: Transfer an active growth point of each excised internode onto MS agar in a magenta vessel. Gently push the cut stem side into the medium and allow the plantlet to develop.

steps.title: Inoculate explants with bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Decant the bacterial suspension into a Petri dish and immerse the explants completely, avoiding agitation. Ensure the explants are fully submerged.

steps.title: Blot explants to remove excess bacteria
steps.instruction: Remove the explants from the suspension with tweezers and briefly blot them on sterile filter paper to remove excess bacterial liquid while leaving the tissue slightly moist.

steps.title: Co‑culture explants on 1/2 MS agar
steps.instruction: Place the blotted explants onto ½ MS agar plates and incubate in the dark at 20 °C. Bacterial growth should become visible around the explants after 24–36 hours.

steps.title: Rinse explants with sterile water
steps.instruction: Rinse the explants twice in Petri dishes each containing 25 mL of autoclaved distilled water.

substeps.instruction: First rinse in 25 mL sterile water.
Second rinse in fresh 25 mL sterile water.

steps.title: Treat explants with Timentin/Augmentin
steps.instruction: Submerge the rinsed explants in a 500 µg/mL solution of Timentin/Augmentin to eliminate residual R. rhizogenes.

steps.title: Transfer explants to selective MS media
steps.instruction: Blot the explants dry thoroughly on sterile filter paper, then transfer them to ½ MS agar supplemented with 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin. Incubate in the dark at 25 °C.

substeps.instruction: Blot explants dry on sterile filter paper.
Place on ½ MS agar + 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin.

steps.title: Isolate and grow putative hairy roots
steps.instruction: When emerging roots reach 2–4 cm in length, excise them and transfer each to a separate ½ MS agar plate containing 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin. Incubate in the dark at 25 °C. Roots that continue growing after excision with a non‑geotropic, highly branched phenotype are considered putative hairy roots.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to ½ MS agar + 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin.

steps.title: Freeze and extract DNA from hairy roots
steps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the putative hairy roots, pulverize the tissue, and extract genomic DNA. Use the DNA extracts for PCR screening of rol and vir genes to confirm successful transformation and bacterial elimination.

steps.title: Sub‑culture hairy roots indefinitely
steps.instruction: Sub‑culture hairy roots by excising actively growing root tips and placing them on or in fresh ½ MS media supplemented with 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin. Repeat this process as needed.

substeps.instruction: Place on/in fresh ½ MS + 200 µg/mL Timentin/Augmentin.
